First, the seed sends out roots downward into the soil. These roots help the plant drink water and get nutrients from the dirt. At the same time, a tiny shoot pushes upward toward the light. This shoot becomes the stem, leaves, and eventually flowers.

Once the leaves reach the sunlight, the plant can make its own food using sunlight, water, and air. This process is called photosynthesis. As the plant keeps growing, it gets taller, makes more leaves, and may even produce flowers and seeds of its own, starting the cycle all over again.
